title: The Impossible Kinetic Optical Illusion #Shorts
description:
This looks like two solid copper rings passing straight through each other, but it is actually a single continuous rotating helix. Your brain struggles to process depth and rotational motion simultaneously, creating the impossible optical illusion of matter passing through matter.
